heroSummary: Beaverton School District lists Tuesday, August 26, 2025, as the first day for students, with a note that first-day dates may be modified by grade level. The 174-day calendar ends Thursday, June 11, 2026. Seniors finish June 4, and June 15–19 remain potential make-up school days if emergency closures leave BSD short of required instructional hours.
calendarNotes: BSD schedules 174 student days in 2025–26, divided into quarters of 45, 41, 42, and 46 days, so the final quarter is the longest. The district calendar marks August 26 as the first day but says grade-level dates may be modified, so families should follow school-specific opening instructions. Fall Break closes schools November 24–28, creating a full Monday-through-Friday break. Winter Break ends January 2 and is followed by a January 5 staff-development day, so students return Tuesday, January 6. Staff-development and grading dates create additional no-student weekdays in September, October, November, January, and April. Seniors finish June 4, all other students finish June 11, and staff have a grading day June 12, so those dates should not be treated as one universal ending. June 15–19 remain potential make-up days unless BSD needs them to recover instructional hours required by the Oregon Department of Education.

customSections.content: These dates are scheduling protections, not a second list of school closures. BSD asks schools to avoid important events and tests, while students observing a religious or cultural holiday may receive an excused absence and time to make up work.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Beaverton School District start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: BSD lists Tuesday, August 26, 2025, as the first day for students. The official calendar says first-day dates may be modified by grade level, so families should use archived school messages for grade-specific opening details.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Beaverton School District Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break ran Monday, November 24, through Friday, November 28, 2025. Students returned Monday, December 1.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Beaverton School District Winter Break in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break ran December 22, 2025, through January 2, 2026. January 5 was a staff-development day with no students, so students returned Tuesday, January 6.

calendarFaqs.q: When was Beaverton School District Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break ran Monday, March 23, through Friday, March 27, 2026. Students returned Monday, March 30.

calendarFaqs.q: What was the last day of Beaverton School District in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The scheduled last day for students was Thursday, June 11, 2026. Seniors finished June 4, and June 15–19 were reserved as potential make-up school days.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days were on the BSD 2025–26 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official Beaverton School District calendar lists 174 student days: 45 in the first quarter, 41 in the second, 42 in the third, and 46 in the fourth.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 9, 2026, against the complete one-page official BSD 2025–26 English district calendar and the district's cultural-observances guidance.
sourceReviewDetails: The PDF was rendered and checked visually because color and symbols distinguish school closures, no-student staff days, first and last days, semester endings, potential make-up days, and cultural observances.
The district PDF lists 174 student days and quarter totals of 45, 41, 42, and 46.
Cultural and religious dates are kept separate from the school-closure list because BSD describes them as dates when schools should avoid important events and tests, not automatic no-school days.
The district PDF says first-day dates may be modified by grade level, so this page does not generalize one school's kindergarten or orientation schedule to the entire district.
The ICS file is a historical one-time import and does not update automatically.
